acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in the data-dependent mode.
cleavage agent: Digestion was performed with Lys-C (Wako 125-05061) (1% w:w enzyme:substrate) for 3 hours at 37°C
enrichment method: 3 mg Titansphere TiO2 beads (10 µm; GL-Sciences 5020 75010) were added per 500 µg peptides for 15 min shaking incubation at room temperature.
fractionation method: High pH reverse phase chromatographic separation was performed on a Agilent Zorbax 300 extend – C18 column (4.6 X 150 mm, 3.5 μm)
fragmentation method: The 10 most abundant ions were selected for fragmentation using higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) and dynamically excluded for 30 seconds.
instrument: run on a LTQ Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
labeling: By combining Stable Isotope Labeling by Amino acids in Cell culture (SILAC) and phosphoproteomic analysis
reduction reagent: proteins were reduced in 20 mM dithiothreitol (DTT), 40 mM ABC for 45 min
reduction concentration: proteins were reduced in 20 mM dithiothreitol (DTT), 40 mM ABC for 45 min
